article.detail:
DemandSense於10月30日宣布加入LinkedIn Marketing Partner Program，並接入Company Intelligence API。

儀表板納入公司層級的付費及自然互動訊號。

平台稱整合已向全部DemandSense客戶提供，涵蓋自然互動及瀏覽後資料。

B2B團隊可檢查較長採購週期中，最後點擊以外的互動。

把新舊歸因報表並列，比對窗口、去重及CRM商機定義。

新增歸因不等於新增需求；公告引用的LinkedIn舊beta成效並非今次DemandSense實測結果。
article.detail_en:
DemandSense announced on October 30 that it joined LinkedIn’s Marketing Partner Program and integrated the Company Intelligence API.

Dashboards add company-level paid and organic engagement.

The company says the integration is available to all its customers, including organic and view-through signals.

B2B teams can examine interactions beyond the last click across longer buying cycles.

Compare old and new reports, reconciling windows, deduplication and CRM opportunity definitions.

More attributed activity is not incremental demand. Historical LinkedIn beta figures are not measured results from this DemandSense rollout.
